Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 22  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that all 97 articles listed in the High Energy Physics - Lattice category for January 2020 had .ps versions available. This conclusion was based on the assumption that the presence of both [pdf] and [other] formats indicated .ps availability, which is not guaranteed. The "other" format could include formats other than .ps, such as source files or other supplementary material. This error in interpreting the metadata led to the incorrect solution of 97 articles instead of the correct answer of 31.
